log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Do all kills as quick entries in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so the pool stays at 55%. L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). If he learns 3 of my places, the pool drops to about 55000*0.25^3, which is under 1000, and I am caught. If he learns only 2, the pool is at least 55000*0.2*0.25=2750, which is safe. So I must find ONE kind L CAN reach (an OMITTED kind) and never kill its victims again, or at most 2 ever in total. After that, kill everything else every day: national plus the other 4 places, about 9 a day. That gets the x4 multiplier, which needs 40 deaths in 5 days. TEST: with 5 or fewer deaths in a day, all are traced, and deaths_traced rises by the number of non-national victims whose trace succeeded. Day 1 test is FORUM: I killed national plus 2 forum. deaths_traced was 0 before day 1. If after day 1 it is 1 or more, forum is reachable: OMIT forum from now on and kill all others daily (national, North, wire, cable, foreign). If it is 0, forum is unreachable and free to kill. Then day 2 test FOREIGN: kill national + forum + 2 foreign (5 deaths). If the count rises, omit foreign and go full. If not, forum and foreign are both unreachable, so the other 3 are all reachable: omit wire (or any one of the 3) and go full with national, North, cable, forum, foreign. Never let the omitted place get 3 traced victims. Watch the pool: if it ever approaches about 2000, stop killing from places at risk.

STRATEGY: Make all kills quick entries in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so the pool stays near 55-60k. Day 1 test: I killed national plus 2 forum, and deaths_traced went from 0 to 2. So FORUM IS REACHABLE, and forum already has 2 successfully traced victims. NEVER KILL FORUM CRIMINALS AGAIN. A third one would let L act on forum. Forum can't get extra hits by accident: the hidden extra outlets are always places I don't follow, and forum is one I do follow. L can reach 3 kinds: forum plus 2 of {regional, sector, age, foreign}. With forum blocked, L can pin down at most 2 of my places. Worst case pool is about 55000*0.2*0.25 = 2750, which is safe. PLAN from day 2: every day kill every criminal reported in national, regional:North, wire, cable or foreign, but not any criminal reported in forum. That is about 9 kills a day, all quick/afternoon. Multiplier outlook: day 2 is 9 kills, so the 5-day total by day 4 is 30 (x2), and from day 6 the window of days 2-6 is 45 (x4). Keep 9 a day to hold x4. If a criminal is listed in both forum and another place, SKIP him, because he is reported in forum. Watch the pool. If it ever drops toward 2000 or below, something unexpected is happening. Then stop killing from the places that look reachable (reduce to national only plus the least risky ones) and reassess. Pool after day 1 was 60000, with traced count 2.

STRATEGY: Make every kill a quick entry in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so the pool stays near 55k (shown as 60k).
FORUM IS REACHABLE. On day 1, 2 forum victims were traced successfully. NEVER kill any criminal whose reported_in includes forum, even if he is also listed in another place. A third forum trace would pin forum. Forum can't pick up extra traces by accident, because hidden extra outlets are always places I don't follow.
L can reach 3 kinds of place: forum plus 2 of {regional, sector, age, foreign}. With forum frozen at 2, L can pin at most 2 of my places. Worst case pool is 55000*0.2*0.25 = 2750, which is safe. A third pinned place (forum) would give about 690, which means CAUGHT. So no forum kills, even to chase a multiplier.
DAILY PLAN: kill every non-forum criminal: national, regional:North, wire, cable, foreign. That is about 9 a day, all quick/afternoon.
KILL LOG: d1 = 3, d2 = 9, d3 = 9 (planned).
MULTIPLIER OUTLOOK (5-day window, counting today):
- d4: 3+9+9+9 = 30, so x2.
- d5: 39, so x2 (1 short of x4; accept it).
- d6 on: 45, so x4. Keep about 9 a day to hold x4.
PRESS LOG:
- after d0: 100k, traced 0
- after d1: 60k, traced 2
- after d2: 60k, traced 6 (4 of d2's traces succeeded; no place has reached 3 yet)
EXPECT: the pool will soon drop to about 15k (one place pinned) and maybe about 3-4k (two pinned). Both are fine.
ALARM: if the pool goes to 2000 or below, or drops in a way the model doesn't explain, cut back to national only plus whatever looks unpinned, and reassess.
